metadata.title: Rethinking TIMSS quality assurance: utilizing neural network models with regression‑based bias mitigation strategies for validating country‑level math and science achievement scores

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study mentions that plausible values are available for each student but does not document how they were combined when training the neural networks.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that student weights were not used in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study describes predicting student-level scores and aggregating them to country-level means without mentioning any multilevel modeling or consideration of school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and focuses solely on internal validation through model predictions and comparisons.
